meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 它会扫描代码库,按功能画出 Mermaid 流程图,找出重复实现的关注点并提出统一架构。产物放在仓库根目录 PATHFINDER-日期/ 文件夹,含流程图、重复报告、统一方案及可复制到 /make-plan 的交接提示词;它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你要求「找到理想路径」、统一重复系统,或在重构前审计架构时触发。它先从功能发现开始,确认功能边界后才继续往下做。

say.text: 扫描这个仓库,按功能画出流程图并给出统一架构建议
say.note: 生成 PATHFINDER-日期/ 产物文件夹

say.text: 找出代码里重复实现的关注点,并给出合并方案
为统一后的每个系统生成 /make-plan 交接提示词

howto.what_en: It scans the codebase, draws feature-grouped Mermaid flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns, and proposes a unified architecture. Outputs sit in PATHFINDER-<date>/: flowcharts, duplication report, proposal, /make-plan prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find the ideal path, unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. It starts with feature discovery, then waits for boundary approval.

say_en.text: Scan this repo, draw flowcharts by feature, and suggest a unified architecture
Find duplicated concerns across features and propose a merge plan
Generate /make-plan handoff prompts for each unified system
